purpose: Bulk-manage the loaded automation rule inventory and install existing geofence routine templates.
primaryGoal: Find rules, inspect their status and cumulative counters, select matching rules, and safely enable, disable or delete the intended selection while retaining builder access.

dataSources.behavior: automationKeys.all, cancellation signal, INTERVALS.STANDARD polling and safeArray selection. Handler calls ListFull and returns base automation rows; page requests no server pagination or enabled filter. Page status/search and table sorting/value filtering/pagination are client-side over the loaded set.
dataSources.limitations: Repository query implementation, actual completeness of live inventory and safeArray implementation not inspected. Full loaded scope must not become a claim of live execution coverage.

dataSources.behavior: Cancellation-aware shared list query with safeArray selection supplies vehicle_id to display_name-or-VIN lookup; absent lookup entries show Vehicle #id and null vehicle_id means All vehicles.
dataSources.limitations: Page does not consume this source's loading/error/retained state. No VIN or location was read from a live response.

dataSources.behavior: Explicit requiresLiveMode, networkMode always, ids/op allowlist, mutation toasts and list/history invalidation+broadcast. Handler prevalidates IDs, returns missing IDs in failed[] with HTTP 200 alongside updated/deleted counts, and reloads existing rules.
dataSources.limitations: No mutation executed; transaction implementation and worker reload effects unverified.

dataSources.behavior: Static-stale-time safeArray catalogue; each RoutineCard owns its install mutation. Encoded template ID plus place_id and template-name/place-name compose the request; success invalidates and broadcasts automation inventory and toasts.
dataSources.limitations: Installation handler internals uninspected. Unlike bulk mutation, hook does not explicitly set requiresLiveMode; page supplies disabled control state. Central request policy was not inspected, so no bypass is asserted.

dataSources.behavior: Default includeArchived=false, dedicated cache key, cancellation signal, safeArray, 15-second staleTime and 30-second polling. Wizard further keeps enabled and non-archived places; selection is local business input, not a competing workspace vehicle selector.
dataSources.limitations: Wizard reads data only and does not distinguish query failure from successful zero eligible places.

dataSources.owner: Existing asynchronous trust, operational-mode context and operational measurement formatting
dataSources.behavior: Main inventory uses fatalError versus retained-data warnings. OperationalModeProvider disables writes for historical and cached/offline contexts. Six full-loaded inventory metrics retain raw count inputs and cumulative-counter provenance through AutomationRulesBrief.
dataSources.limitations: useDataState and metric formatter internals not inspected. List is inventory, not a dated history page; no date bounds were invented.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.usage: Full allocated width, min-w-0 orchestration, title/subtitle, context filters and primary New action; delegates shell behavior.

components.name: AutomationRulesBrief / OperationalBrief
components.usage: Six metrics in bulk mode, scope/freshness/provenance and loading/unavailable/retained status; shared presentation, not replacement KPI cards.

components.name: AutomationListTable / DataTable
components.usage: Seven data columns, controlled field-correct sort, local value filters, multi-selection/shift range/select all, pagination, loaded/selected export and stable automations:bulk-list persistence.

components.name: AutomationStatusPanel / MetricBar / AlertBanner
components.usage: Unfiltered active/disabled/auto-disabled proportions, numeric text and actionable auto-disable explanation; loading/empty/fatal-error branches.

components.name: BulkActionToolbar alias / BulkActionsToolbar / ConfirmDialog
components.usage: One existing implementation, sticky height guard, wrapped action labels, per-action pending state, visible disabled reasons, destructive confirmation and polite selection summary.

components.name: RoutineWizard / local RoutineCard
components.usage: Eligible-place selection and source-driven enter/exit routine cards with action count, description and install state; only RoutineWizard is exported.

components.name: Button, Input, Select, GlassPanel, Badge, Text, PanelTitle
components.usage: Localized named controls, surfaces, semantic status labels and typography; existing primitives rather than raw form/table elements.

components.name: OperationalWriteNotice, StaleRefreshWarning, QueryError, EmptyState, Skeleton, VisuallyHidden
components.usage: Read-only explanation, retained inventory warning, retry, first-rule/no-match states, named loading region.

components.name: FadeIn
components.usage: Three section entrances; existing motion preference removes initial reveal and delay when reduction is requested.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page name/description search coexists with DataTable default local search and seven column value filters. They are separate predicates and separate result scopes, not interchangeable search controls.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use the existing DataTable controls/filter contract to make scope explicit and avoid redundant search chrome; preserve status, name/description search and every existing value-filter capability.

sourceStrategy: Header controls flex-wrap, search w-full then sm:w-56; status select w-40. Page table/status layout stacks until xl then uses 2:1 columns.
Table has mobileColumns name/status; DataTable hides other five columns below md. It supplies no mobilePresentation or expandable detail adapter.
Routine cards use one, two at sm, and four at lg columns; place wrapper min-w-52/flex-1/sm:max-w-72. Install controls remain full-width.
Shared bulk toolbar wraps and stops sticking when its measured height reaches the viewport.

issues.detail: Below md only name/status remain visible; vehicle, description, runs, failures and last-triggered fields have no page-provided mobile detail view. CSV export is not a substitute for readable mobile metadata. Builder link currently targets an unregistered route.
issues.fix: Adopt existing DataTable mobilePresentation/full-detail capability with all seven values, selection, sorting and export, and repair builder destination; do not discard columns.

issues.detail: Four routine cards begin at lg even though available allocated content width may be much smaller than viewport; source titles truncate and descriptions line-clamp to two lines without an expansion control.
issues.fix: Use existing container-aware grid/layout contracts and retain complete routine identity/description through an accessible detail affordance; validate long labels and 200% text before choosing breakpoints.

responsive.requiredChecks: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, allocated shell/container width, long localized names, 200% text, selected rows, open delete confirmation and routine loading/error; not exercised.

positiveSourceEvidence: Search and status filter have localized aria-labels; routine Place uses shared Select label association; primary/search/section/routine icons carry aria-hidden.
Table initial loading has role=status, aria-busy and VisuallyHidden localized text; shared DataTable provides caption, row labels, selection/sort announcements.
Status badges and MetricBar numeric/sublabel text prevent color-only status communication.
Bulk toolbar names its region, politely announces selection, associates disabled reasons, and reuses ConfirmDialog rather than a second focus system.
FadeIn source honors shared reduced-motion preference; browser/OS behavior remains unverified.

issues.detail: Rule link uses text-only local chrome with no explicit target sizing/focus styling and description truncates without a reveal. Actual default browser focus and spacing exceptions have not been measured.
issues.fix: Preserve native Link semantics and localized rule identity while using shared focus/target styling and a keyboard/touch-accessible full-description view.

issues.detail: Status Select uses default md sizing, whose source minimum is 40px rather than the contract's stronger 44px mobile default. Routine installs use size=sm; their computed target size was not inspected.
issues.fix: Use existing appropriate shared mobile target sizing and test target spacing, not a new primitive.

issues.detail: Prop comment promises Clear plus Escape, and component header says Escape is consumer-owned; inspected toolbar has no Escape handler and page has no keyboard handler. Escape-to-clear behavior is not source-backed in this composition.
issues.fix: Resolve keyboard ownership using existing interaction contracts, preserving modal Escape priority and avoiding a competing global listener.

accessibility.evidenceLimits: No keyboard, screen reader, focus restoration, effective contrast, forced-colors or real touch-target test. Shared ConfirmDialog focus internals not inspected.

states.initialLoading: Main inventory uses !hasData plus query.isLoading; table exposes five skeleton rows, status panel a 168px skeleton, brief shared loading. Routine catalogue shows four source-independent skeleton cards.
states.empty: Zero inventory keeps table/status/brief sections and offers builder navigation. Filtered zero matches remains a DataTable no-match message. No templates returns null from RoutineWizard; eligible-place zero shows a geofence setup explanation.
states.fatalError: Inventory fatalError appears in summary, table and status panel with retry. Routine template error uses its own QueryError/refetch. Vehicles and places expose no caller-level failure/retry.
states.refreshError: Inventory retained rows and metrics remain under StaleRefreshWarning and Retained rules status. RoutineWizard uses raw isError, so a refresh error replaces retained routine cards with QueryError.
states.offline: Operational mode disables New, bulk mutations and routine installs, and inventory warning handles refresh-blocked state through shared DataState. Cold offline behavior is unverified.
states.unknownUnavailable: Brief hasData=false passes null count metrics and marks rules unavailable. Page/table cumulative counters default missing values to zero; vehicle lookup falls back to ID. No additional backend availability envelope was invented.
states.partialMutation: HTTP-success bulk response can include failed[]; current hook reports generic success and page clears all selection without consuming those failures.

issues.detail: Geofence loading/error/unavailable all become [] and the same Create a geofence message; catalogue empty returns null. Catalogue raw isError replaces retained cards on refresh failure.
issues.fix: Use existing per-source DataState, preserve wizard section identity and retained templates, and distinguish eligible-place empty, loading, failure, paused and stale with independent retry.

issues.detail: Vehicle query data-only destructuring conceals lookup loading/failure/retained status. Vehicle #id fallback is safe but does not explain failed name resolution.
issues.fix: Surface existing independent vehicle-source trust/retry without replacing otherwise usable automation rows.

issues.detail: Missing execution/failure counters are summed as zero before the brief sees them; table also renders/exports zero for missing counters. This preserves current behavior but cannot prove a measured zero from malformed/partial data.
issues.fix: Retain legitimate zero counts, and agree on typed missing-counter semantics at the source adapter rather than guessing or silently changing totals.

visualIssues.detail: Every routine card explicitly requests cyan glow and hover treatment inside another GlassPanel; cyan-500 icon decoration and cyan-400/300 accents spread emphasis across secondary catalogue cards.
visualIssues.fix: Remove decorative glow and use existing neutral surfaces/icon tokens, reserving semantic emphasis for meaningful status/action feedback. Retain all cards and install controls.

visualIssues.detail: Feature-local fixed emerald/slate/rose hex palette competes with canonical semantic tokens. Table link/section icons use fixed cyan-300 and failure text fixed rose-300. Source intent is semantic in bars/failure counts, but rendered saturation and light-theme contrast are unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subdued semantic tokens and theme-aware link/icon/text roles; preserve status meanings, three series and numeric labels.

architectureIssues.detail: Rule links target /automations/{id}; inspected App registers /automations/:id/edit, not /automations/:id. This contradicts the page subtitle promising editor access. No such editor route appeared in the scoped App route search.
architectureIssues.fix: Point this existing Link to the registered builder destination /automations/{id}/edit; retain editor and its run/delete capabilities, not a new router or page.

architectureIssues.detail: effectiveSelected prunes only outer status/name-description filters. DataTable applies additional search/value filters internally and deliberately preserves selected rows outside those filters. Page's filtered selection scope/count and bulk IDs therefore need not match rows currently shown by the table.
architectureIssues.fix: Expose the existing composed loaded-filter result via the DataTable controller/adapter contract, or explicitly label retained hidden selections and provide review. Preserve intentional cross-page selection and all filters; never silently expand destructive scope.

architectureIssues.detail: Bulk onSuccess ignores failed[] and emits generic success; page awaits success then clears all selectedKeys. Backend explicitly returns HTTP 200 with missing-ID failures. Retry selection guarantee only covers rejected requests, not partial HTTP-success outcomes.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing typed AutomationBulkResult to present updated/deleted and failed IDs/reasons, retaining failed selection for review/retry while maintaining invalidation and mutation guards.

priority.rationale: Source-confirmed broken editor destination, destructive-selection scope ambiguity and unreported partial bulk failure take precedence over cosmetic work. Existing modern layout/brief/table composition should be retained.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Composed table-filter and retained-selection scope contract
requiredSharedChanges.concreteContract: Prefer existing table controller/adapter capabilities; if absent, a typed integration-owned readback of composed matching loaded row IDs/count and hidden selected count. Keep selectedKeys/onSelectionChange, value filters, local search, pagination, export scopes and stable tableId. Do not add a second query/state engine.
requiredSharedChanges.classification: Existing-contract integration gap, not authorization for a speculative shared component

requiredSharedChanges.name: Typed bulk partial-outcome presentation
requiredSharedChanges.concreteContract: Consume existing AutomationBulkResult.updated/deleted/failed[{id,reason}]; distinguish complete success, partial success and request failure, retain failed IDs for review and preserve live-only guards, toast policy and broadcast invalidation.
requiredSharedChanges.classification: Integration-owned use of existing backend response, no new endpoint

requiredSharedChanges.name: Bulk toolbar Escape ownership
requiredSharedChanges.concreteContract: Resolve documented onClear/Escape ownership through the existing keyboard/overlay policy, giving open confirmation dialog Escape precedence; retain Clear button and focus.
dependsOn: existing ConfirmDialog/useConfirm focus and Escape policy
requiredSharedChanges.classification: Existing shared contract/documentation mismatch; no second overlay system

competingImplementations.detail: Feature-local status hex palette competes with canonical semantic tokens; consolidate by reuse.
Outer search and table-local search create overlapping but distinct loaded-filter pipelines. Preserve capabilities while clarifying/unifying control ownership.
Singular name is an alias of existing plural implementation, not a competing toolbar. Do not replace it with a new implementation.

preservation.hashScope: Exact bytes of assigned root page, not concatenated dependencies
sections: Full-loaded rule summary: total, active, disabled, auto-disabled, cumulative runs and failures
Conditional sticky selected-rule actions and destructive confirmation
Selectable inventory table plus three-status breakdown and auto-disable attention
Geofence place selection and source-driven routine catalogue cards/install controls
actions: New rule navigation to /automations/new with write guard
Status all/active/disabled/auto-disabled and trimmed case-insensitive name/description search
Rule link/editor access; current /automations/{id} target must be reconciled to registered /automations/:id/edit
DataTable local search, seven value filters, column persistence/resizing/reordering/density and client pagination inherited from existing table pipeline
Multi-select, select-all across matching loaded table rows, additive shift range and Clear
Bulk enable/disable and confirmed irreversible delete; pending indicators, write reasons, successful invalidation and request-failure retry selection
Independent inventory/template retries and empty-state builder navigation
Eligible-place selection and per-template enter/exit routine install, action count and complete source descriptions
dataBehavior: Summary/status derive from unfiltered loaded inventory, not table page or search matches.
Auto-disabled takes priority over enabled/disabled classification; counts and status meanings must survive.
Routine templates/actions come from API, eligible places are enabled and not archived; installation retains place_id and composed name.
Retained inventory remains readable after refresh failure; raw SI/wire/cache values and query keys must remain unchanged.
No fake data, added server capabilities, workspace selector duplication or executed mutations.

The sibling card-based /automations page and builder run/delete actions are outside this one-page audit. Preserve their destinations/actions; direct test-run, single-rule delete and card-browse controls are not mounted by this bulk page. Hook and router source confirms existing test-run and single-delete endpoints, but their destination UI was not audited.

evidenceLimits.basis: Read-only bounded source inspection plus source hash/line-count commands; no source edits or Git.
validationNotRun: No TypeScript, full-repository lint/build or browser automation during Phase 0.
The audit skill script was inspected but not executed because it unconditionally runs full frontend TypeScript; bounded source-pattern search used instead.
No live data fetch, installation, enable/disable, delete, test-run, export download or editor interaction.
No source claim of overall no-data/feature-loss or historical runtime acceptance.
evidenceLimits.boundedPatternResult: Search of the five narrow page/dependency TSX files found one explicit glow prop, cyan and rose fixed text accents. No matched neon or pure-white literal decoration, raw button/input/table, inline style or direct recharts import in that exact search scope. Shared theme/primitives were not globally scanned, so this is not whole-page composed visual clearance.
evidenceLimits.scopeUnknowns: Builder/card presentation, safeArray validation, shared request enforcement, DataState internals, full table controller API, shared dialog focus, routine backend semantics and SQL transaction details remain uninspected.
